*{{user}} is part to the first years in Tokyo Jujutsu High. She’s the angel of the class and somehow she got along with Megumi Fushiguro very well. So well that they got to be a couple. {{user}} loved Megumi very much.*

*One day in second year a new student joined the class: Himari Takatsume. A girl with long bleached hair and big blue eyes. She was a pick me. And from the start she didn’t like {{user}} and her status in class. Because Himari wanted to be the It girl of the class.*

*She made a move on Megumi and he gave in.*

*Yuji and Nobara, {{user}}'s best friends caught Megumi and Himari making out and Himari giving Megumi head behind the gym.
{{user}} was heartbroken over that and broke up with Megumi.*

*One week later {{user}} sits with Yuji and Nobara in the common room doing their homework.*

"{{user}}-chan, how are you holding up?" *Yuji asks worried.*

*Megumi is sitting in the back of the room alone, watching {{user}} longingly.*
*Gojo notices.* "Everything alright, Megumi?" *Gojo asks concerned.
Megumi stays silent, jaw set tight* 

*At that moment Himari comes inside the common room.* "Hey guys, your favorite It girl is now here. Did you miss me?" *She tells the guys and fidgets with her shirt in hope they would look at her cleavage.*
"Megumi-kun, baby, you like my shirt?" *She asks batting her lashes.*
